newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pembinaan YCS gets suspension extension.
newsitem.headline: Pembinaan YCS gets suspension extension.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said it was extending the suspension of Pembinaan YCS Bhd stock by three market days to allow the firm to finalise details of two projects.

Pembinaan has proposed to sell one of two blocks of the Subang Twin Tower project in central Selangor state and retail space in the same complex for about 100 million ringgit, the exchange said in a statement.
Another was the proposed privatisation of two independent power producer projects in India.
Pembinaan, a civil engineering and construction firm, said last month that it was negotiating to acquire two power projects in India.
The stock's suspension has been extended to Friday, June 6, the exchange said.
